title: Episode 2
summary: A couple's therapist is found drowned.
method: The victim was sedated during the killer’s therapy session. She went swimming and drifted onto the beach near the victim’s room. The killer left dinner for a few minutes to push her into the water and apply pressure to her neck so it would appear that she was strangled.
motive: To prevent a hypnotherapy session with his wife to uncover the secret that he was responsible for the hit-and-run that killed his daughter.
killer: One of the patients who is there for grief counselling
